objective.text: Measure endpoint query count and latency before selecting caching as the remedy.

difficulty.rationale: Use measurements to distinguish database cost from the rest of request handling.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A Laravel endpoint takes 900 ms. Before adding a response cache, which measurement best distinguishes database work from other time in the request?

options.text: Compare cache-hit latency after caching and assume it identifies the original bottleneck.
options.rationale: A cache hit bypasses much of the endpoint and does not attribute its original cost.
options.misconception: A cache hit bypasses much of the endpoint and does not attribute its original cost.

options.text: Record query count and cumulative query time alongside total endpoint duration.
options.rationale: Comparing database time and frequency with the complete request establishes where further investigation belongs.

options.text: Record only the number of Eloquent models defined in the application.
options.rationale: Model definitions do not measure queries actually executed by this request.
options.misconception: Model definitions do not measure queries actually executed by this request.

options.text: Record only the duration of the final SQL query.
options.rationale: The last query can omit earlier queries and non-database work.
options.misconception: The last query can omit earlier queries and non-database work.
